spans.s: प्रति—दण्ड mfn. refractory under the rod, disobedient, obstinate, TāṇḍBr.
प्रति—दन्तिन् m. = -कुञ्जर, Kir.
प्रति—दन्˚त्य्—अनीकम् ind. against the army of elephants, ib.
प्रति—दिनम् and प्रति—दिवसम्, ind. day by day, daily, every day, Kāv.; Var.; Pañcat.
प्रति—दिनम् and प्रति—दिवसम्, ind. day by day, daily, every day, Kāv.; Var.; Pañcat.
प्रति—दिशम् ind. in every direction or quarter, all around, GṛŚrS.; Megh. &c.
प्रति-˚दिशम् and ˚देशम्, see p. 662, col. 1.
प्रति—दूत m. a messenger sent in return, Rājat.; Kathās.
प्रति—दृश् mfn. similar, like, TS.
प्रति-˚दृश् See p. 662, col. 1.
प्रति—दृशम् ind. in or for every eye, BhP.
प्रति-˚दृशम् See p. 662, col. 1.
प्रति—दृष्टान्त m. a counter example, Nyāyas.
प्रति-˚दृष्˚टान्त See p. 662, col. 1.
प्रति—दृष्टान्त—सम m. an irrelevant objection by adducing a c˚ ex˚ which ignores the opponent's example, ib.
प्रति—देवता f. a corresponding deity, MuṇḍUp.
प्रति—देवतम् ind. = -दैवतम्, KātyŚr.
प्रति—देशम् ind. = -दिशम्, Var.; Rājat.
प्रति-˚दिशम् and ˚देशम्, see p. 662, col. 1.
प्रति—देहम् ind. in each body, Śaṃk.
प्रति—दैवतम् ind. for each deity, ib.
प्रति—दोष॑म् ind. in the evening, in the dark, RV.
प्रति—द्वंद्व m. an adversary, rival, foe (in अ-प्रतिद्व्˚), MBh.; R. &c.
प्रति—द्वंद्व n. opposition, hostility, W.
प्रति—द्वं˚द्वय Nom. P. ˚यति, to rival, Divyāv.
प्रति—द्वं˚द्विन् m. = ˚द्व m. (ifc. vying with), MBh.; Kāv.
प्रति—द्वं˚द्वी—भूत mfn. being an adv˚, Śaṃk.
प्रति—द्वादशन् mfn. pl. twelve in each case, Gaut.
प्रति—द्वारम् (Kathās.) ind. at every gate or door.
प्रति—द्वारि (BhP.) ind. at every gate or door.
प्रति—द्विप m. = -कुञ्जर, Kir.
प्रति—द्विरद m. id., MBh.; Hariv.
प्रति—द्वीपम् ind. in every part of the world, Hcar.

प्रति-√ दह् P. -दहति (fut. -धक्ष्यति), to burn towards, encounter with flames, consume, RV.; AV.; ŚBr.; ChUp. :
Pass. -दह्यते (˚ति), to be burnt or consumed by fire, MBh.
प्रति-˚दातव्य mfn. to be given back or restored, Yājñ.
प्रति-˚दान n. restitution (of a deposit), restoration, L.
giving or a gift in return, Daś.; Pāṇ. i, 4, 92
exchange, barter, L. (v.l. for परि-द्˚).
प्रति-˚दाप्य mfn. to be caused to be restored, Āpast.
प्रति-˚देय mfn. to be given back or returned, Yājñ.; MBh.
प्रति-˚देय n. a pledge, pawn
an article purchased and given back, W.
battle, fighting, fierce conflict, L.
प्रति-˚दिवन् m. the sun, L.
a day, Uṇ. i, 156, Sch.
प्रति-˚दी॑वन् m. an adversary at play, RV.; AV.
the sun, L.

प्रति-√ दिश् Caus. -देशयति, to point towards, point out, MBh.;
to confess, L.
प्रति-˚देशनीय mfn. to be reported or related, L.
flaming against, MBh.

प्रति-√ दुह् (P. impf. -अदुहत् aor. -अधुक्षत्), to add by milking, TS.;
 (P. Pot. -दुहीयत्, A. Subj. -दोहते) to yield (like milk), grant, RV. (cf. Nir. i, 7).
प्रति-˚दु॑ह् n. (nom. धुक्; gen. instr. also धुषस्, ˚षा) fresh milk, milk still warm, AV.; TS.; MaitrS.; Br.; ŚrS.
defiled, rendered unclean, contaminated, Mn. iv, 65.
प्रति-˚दर्श m. (cf. प्रती-द्˚) looking at, viewing, ŚāṅkhŚr.
प्रती—दर्श॑ m. (cf. प्रति-द्˚) N. of a man, ŚBr.
प्रति-˚दर्शन n. id., R.
प्रति-˚दर्शना f. sight, look, appearance, MBh.
प्रति-˚दृष्ट mfn. beheld, visible, conspicuous, famous, celebrated, BhP. (= प्र-ख्यात, Sch.)
प्रति-√ द्रु (only aor. -अदुद्रुवत्), to run towards (acc.), Bhaṭṭ.
one who seeks to injure in return (अ-प्˚), BhP.
प्राति—दैवसिक mf(ई)n. (fr. -दिवसम्) happening or occurring daily, Āryabh.
